objective: Candidate rotates a pizza on an oven stone; PR-2051 spins lettuce in a hand-crank salad spinner to remove water.
physical_skill: Candidate requires peel insertion, repeated tangential traction, and center correction; PR-2051 requires one hand stabilizing a low-friction bowl while the other repeatedly cranks fast enough to drive a geared basket.
success_condition: Candidate scores pizza yaw and continuous geometric/contact safeguards. PR-2051 scores measured water removal, release of the crank, and preservation of lid, tilt, and base-position constraints.
reason: Repeated rotary motion is not enough for overlap: crank operation and vessel stabilization test a different mechanism and outcome from peel-mediated pizza turning.
